title: Test Integration Drafts with workflowId
summary: The `GoogleInternalCloudCrmEventbusV3PostToQueueWithTriggerIdRequest` now supports a `workflowId` field, allowing you to enqueue tasks against specific, even unpublished, workflow versions for testing.
details: A new optional `workflowId` string field has been added to the `GoogleInternalCloudCrmEventbusV3PostToQueueWithTriggerIdRequest` schema. This enables developers to pin an enqueue operation to a particular workflow version, facilitating testing of unpublished drafts without affecting the active version. This is particularly useful for pre-release validation of integration logic.
